doc: Build a one-hot matrix from ids and multiply it by the table: out = onehot(ids) @ table.
name: one_hot_gemm
reference:
def fn(ids, table, num_classes):
    ids = ids.long().reshape(-1)
    oh = torch.zeros(ids.shape[0], num_classes, dtype=table.dtype, device=table.device)
    oh[torch.arange(ids.shape[0]), ids] = 1.0
    return oh @ table
